english.note: Use this all-purpose noun when discussing the length or duration of something, including how brief a reply is, but not a person's stature.

examples.english: The shortness of this email makes it easy to read.
examples.traditional: 呢封電郵嘅長短啱啱好，睇落唔會攰。
